components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with pill geometry and subtle purple glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6258F5; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(98,88,245,0.24); transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #756BFF; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(98,88,245,0.32); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Soft Button
components.description: Subtle lilac button for secondary choices and filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #EFEDFF; color: #6258F5; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #E2DFFF; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #E3DFFF; color: #5146E0; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: White rounded card surface with ghost border and ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E9EAF2; border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(23,33,61,0.03); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #858BA0; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-val { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #20243A; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-unit { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #858BA0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Rounded input with subtle background and purple glow focus ring.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="e.g. ข้าวมันไก่ต้ม" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #F6F7FB; border: 1px solid #E9EAF2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 13px; color: #20243A; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #6258F5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(98,88,245,0.14); }

components.name: Category Meal Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-lunch { background: #F0F4FF; color: #6258F5; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-block; }

narrative.overview: NubCal’s design language marries the clean, authoritative precision of modern European SaaS dashboards (inspired by Jobgio) with the warmth, tactile softness, and high-frequency usability demanded by personal nutrition tracking in Thailand. The interface is light-first, quiet, and profoundly respectful of the user's attention.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp, airy canvas with a calming cool fog background (#F6F7FB) and pure white cards (#FFFFFF)
Distinctive electric purple focal points (#6258F5) balanced by deep night navy (#17213D)
Soft, pill-shaped interactive geometry (rounded-full) contrasting structured cards (24px radius)
Intentional, functional micro-interactions (fast 150ms transitions, smooth ease-out curves)
Strict light-theme discipline ensuring universal contrast and no washed-out text

rules.name: The 90/10 Canvas Rule
rules.body: 90% of the visible surface consists of quiet neutrals (#F6F7FB, #FFFFFF, #E9EAF2). The vibrant purple accent (#6258F5) never exceeds 10% of any viewport. Its scarcity preserves its signaling power.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: #000000 is strictly forbidden for typography and strokes. All dark surfaces and text must use #20243A or #17213D to maintain soft, sophisticated contrast.

rules.name: The Numeric Prominence Rule
rules.body: Calorie counts and macro quantities (kcal, g, mg) must always be rendered in bold (font-weight: 700) with explicit units in secondary slate (#858BA0), ensuring numbers can be parsed at an arm's length.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface (card, modal, popover) must carry a crisp 1px stroke of #E9EAF2 alongside any ambient shadow.

rules.name: The Pill vs. Container Rule
rules.body: Micro-surfaces (buttons, filter chips, meal tags, status badges) must ALWAYS use fully rounded pill geometry (rounded-full). Macro-surfaces (cards, panels, modals) must ALWAYS use rounded rectangular geometry (20px–28px).

dos: Do maintain the 90/10 canvas ratio: keep backgrounds and cards predominantly white and light gray.
Do use pill buttons (rounded-full) for all action triggers and category selectors.
Do show Thai and English names in bilingual harmony for local food dishes.
Do use smooth ease-out curves (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for all state transitions under 200ms.
Do keep touch targets on mobile at a minimum of 44×44px.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) for text or background fills.
Don't introduce heavy gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism, or multi-colored glow effects.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing animations; motion must be refined and professional.
Don't hide sodium and sugar metrics behind deep submenus; keep them visible on meal logs.
Don't allow cards on mobile to clip or trigger horizontal scrolling.
